description: Known V1 platform and supply-chain limits. Not a performance certification claim.

limits.summary: Certification presets lock macOS 27.2 / Xcode 27.2 on Apple Silicon; older hosts are unsupported for reference evidence.
vcpkg manifest dependencies stay empty; configure does not download or bootstrap vcpkg until the first package is integrated in manifest mode.
Root Node packages are authoring/tooling only (no runtime dependency). Integrity hashes in package-lock.json gate installs.
HarfBuzz, FreeType and ICU are resolved via pkg-config (Homebrew), not content-hashed in-tree; minimum versions live in third_party/typography-deps/PIN.json.
stb_image is retained with importer dimension/budget limits; upstream documents preferring Wuffs when security is the top priority.
Apple system frameworks are not fully instrumented under project sanitizers; green ASan/TSan does not imply complete OS encoder/Metal/driver coverage.
metal-cpp archive_sha256 pins the upstream tarball identity; the vendored header tree is gated by tag/commit/hash fields checked at CMake configure.
Release and style asset locks verify offline; builds must not fetch fonts, textures or pins from the network.
